_notes: Towers = disciples (ศิษย์) of a sect placed on the map. dmg per hit, rate = hits/s, range in tiles, cost in silver (ตำลึง). Values are prototype balance targets. All sect names are original (no Jin Yong / Gu Long IP).

rules.generateAdjacency: a disciple adjacent to a disciple of the element that generates it gains +15% dmg (สร้างเสริม / 相生)
rules.overcomeVsEnemy: damage vs enemy of the element it overcomes x1.5; vs the element that overcomes it x0.7 (ข่มกัน / 相克)

comboTechniques._comboRule: merged form: (dmg A + dmg B) x comboDmgPct, cooldown = average of both, range = longer; keeps merged/separate DPS within 1.1-1.3 for every pair (design-review B4)
comboTechniques._notes: ยุทธ์ผสาน: merge two max-level disciples of different Wu Xing sects -> a duo master. 10 pairs (C(5,2)). Generating pairs lean support, overcoming pairs lean damage.
